info.title: Gobi MCP HTTP API
info.description: REST mapping of the Gobi MCP tools for agents that cannot speak MCP. Same core as the MCP server. Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer (OAuth 2.1 access token or gbi_ / Gobi access token). Generated from src/catalog.ts.

get.description: Current activity, recent activities, notes, captures.

schema.description: Window start: duration (24h, 7d, 30m) or ISO timestamp. Default 24h.
Pagination cursor (nextCursor) from a previous list call.
Pagination cursor (nextCursor) from a previous list call.
Max capture notifications to return (default 30, max 100).

get.description: Search personal Sense notes (`query`; deprecated alias `q`). Backend GET /app/conversations/search?q= (TODO if 404).

schema.description: Search query over note titles, summaries, and speakers.
Deprecated alias for query. Prefer query. Mapped to the same backend `q` parameter.

get.description: People directory. Backend GET /app/people (Jimin / TODO if 404).

schema.description: People DB id (when the backend exists).
